_comment: 'When this attacks' = TRIGGERED + ON_ATTACK (the trigger is on attacking, not on dealing damage); shape copied from shipped ako/pound_town_blue.json, which carries the identical beat-chest gate: EVENT_THIS_TURN event=beat_chest reads the marker recorded by KEYWORD_COSTS['beat_chest'] exactly when the player pays it (costs/effect_costs.py; recording and reading sides normalize identically - _norm_ident in effect_keywords.py:568 vs _norm in condition_types.py), so declining the cost correctly fails the gate, and beating chest on ANY card earlier this turn counts because the marker is player-scoped across the turn (matches the release ruling for this wording family). Printed BeatChest keyword is deliberately NOT authored here - it fires from the card DB keywords field, and re-authoring a printed keyword is a defect. DEVIATION FROM TRIAGE on the second clause: triage said NOT CONTROLS_SUBTYPE(Chest), but CONTROLS_SUBTYPE scans ONLY player.permanents (condition_types.py ~1840) while chest equipment lives in the dedicated chest slot zone (deck.py:27 routes subtype Chest there at deck build; state.py:37 admits subtypes Chest/Base) - that gate would be vacuously true, so the +2{p} would apply even while controlling chest equipment, silently doing the opposite of the printed restriction. Used NOT CARD_IN_ZONE zones:[chest] instead: by construction anything in the chest slot IS a chest equipment, so zone occupancy is the faithful test - and deliberately with NO subtype filter, because filtering on [Chest] alone would miss Base-subtyped chest pieces that state.py:37 also routes to that slot. Ability-level conditions are evaluated at trigger resolution (interpreter.py:55), which matches 'When this attacks, if ...' timing; both clauses are live checks, so a chest piece destroyed or removed mid-turn flips the gate correctly. The +2{p} goes through MODIFY_ATTACK's one-shot path, recording on combat.power_mods so it survives later recalculations (effect_types.py:4081-4087). No known gaps.
